$comment: Gate G6 — the span shape one representative request must produce in all three languages.
Compared key-for-key by code/tests/integration_test/tracing_parity_test.ps1 against the output
of each language's dump script. The comparison is EXACT, not a subset: that is the whole point.
A per-language test asserts the attributes that are there and never the ones that are not, so
an extra attribute in one implementation passes every existing suite. This fixture is the only
Ids, timestamps and durations are excluded deliberately — they differ every run and belong to
the SDK. Parentage is by NAME, which is stable and is what a waterfall shows.
The request: POST /api/cuenta/detalle with an X-Request-ID header, whose handler starts one
nested client span through ambient context alone. The header is sent so the one conditional
attribute is covered; the nested span is the mechanism the satellite packages use to parent
their spans, so comparing it here compares theirs without core depending on them.
